title_as_printed: Experimental solubility data of oxygen in aqueous sodium sulfate solutions
pressure_note: Abstract/text: 'oxygen (nitrogen) partial pressure of 1 atm'; total pressure in the vessel was recorded and the water vapour pressure of the solution (Timmermans table for Na2SO4; for Na2SO3 the Na2SO4 curve at same molarity was used) enters the evaluation of L, i.e. gas partial pressure 1 atm excluding water vapour
volume_basis_evidence: 'L = VG/VL' (Eq. 1): 'the ratio of the volume of gas absorbed to the volume of the absorbing liquid'; Nomenclature: 'VG volume of gas dissolved in aqueous salt solution at observed temperature and pressure [cm3]', 'VL volume of aqueous salt solution [cm3]'; Cs liquid-phase concentration of salt [mol/l]. A small liquid volume increase due to gas absorption was corrected with partial molal volumes (31 cm3/mol O2, 40 cm3/mol N2).
conversion_needs: mol/l of solution to molality needs solution density
notes: Three side-by-side blocks (15, 25, 35 C) printed next to each other, stacked in that order. Cs = 0.0 rows are pure-water values (same as Table 1 averages). Replicate-like rows kept (25 C: 0.510/0.513, 1.228/1.240).
